meta.title: The BEST Hội An Cooking Class and Basket Boats - Vietnam
meta.description:
A sister's birthday meant planning for a Vietnamese cooking class with Ms Hanh while visiting Hội An. Ms Hanh's class came highly recommended, especially for accommodating and including young children, and we had a 4 year old wanting to take part!

The occasion was made all the more memorable by the crazy spinning speeds of the Basket Boat ride that prefaced the class, quickly showing us another reason why we had been told to eat only a light breakfast!!! The Basket Boat experience includes many more aspects than just the rowing in the coconut forest so ensure you do not miss this trip!

This occasion is part of a family reunion holiday for three international sisters and their families so this video record and the photographs have great value to us.

https://mshanhcookingclass.com/
